description: Failing cases and mathematical oracles for branching/loop bounds, invalid transitions, progression during waiting, covariate changes, stale events, ties, zero-targets, analytic competing risks, and draw ownership.

invariants_matrix.branching_loop_bounds: Max repetition limits enforced; cycles exceeding bound fail closed with LoopBoundExceeded.
invariants_matrix.invalid_transitions: Unregistered stages and disjoint stage jumps fail closed with InvalidTransition.
invariants_matrix.progression_during_waiting: Clinical hazard accumulates independently of physical server/bed allocation (CC-04).
invariants_matrix.elapsed_age_residual_time: Proportional hazard scaling recalculates residual time on covariate changes without discontinuity.
invariants_matrix.stale_events_ties: Stale events rejected on patient generation increment; deterministic tie-breaking by (tick, priority, event_id, patient_id).
invariants_matrix.zero_target_accounting: Immediate service targets (0 ticks) evaluate breach ratio cleanly without NaN or division by zero (CC-06).
invariants_matrix.analytic_competing_risks: Competing hazard probabilities match exact theoretical fractions (lambda_i / lambda_total); zero hazard halts progression.
invariants_matrix.unchanged_covariates: Unchanged covariates produce bit-identical hazard rates across evaluations.
invariants_matrix.right_censoring: Events scheduled past horizon are clamped and right-censored without unauthorized state changes.
invariants_matrix.draw_ownership: Decoupled RNG streams (Progression, Service, Routing) ensure retries/calibration of one subsystem cannot leak into another (CC-07).
